primitives.name: Frozen Projection Regressor
primitives.verbatim_quote: A 2025 slope is how a frozen projection regresses toward the actual stat on that season block (yards for the yard props, receptions for receptions).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\hat{y}_{\\text{actual}}': 'Actual stat estimate (dimensionless)', '\\beta_{\\text{slope}}': 'Regression coefficient (dimensionless)', '\\hat{y}_{\\text{frozen}}': 'Frozen projection (yards or receptions)', 'y_{\\text{observed}}': 'Observed stat (yards or receptions)'}
primitives.assumptions: Stat regressions follow linear decay from frozen projection; 2025 data is representative of current season variance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When 2025 slope is undefined or zero, regressor becomes identity.

layer2.mapping: Maps frozen projections to calibrated stat estimates using position-specific regression coefficients.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute error (MAE) of regression against observed stats.

primitives.name: Position Slope Calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: `by_position` exists for every position mapped below, so each player row uses the 2025 position slope, not the prop-level slope.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\beta_{\\text{pos}}': 'Position-specific regression slope (dimensionless)', 'x_i': 'Frozen projection value (yards/receptions)', 'y_i': 'Actual stat value (yards/receptions)', '\\bar{x}': 'Mean frozen projection (yards/receptions)', '\\bar{y}': 'Mean actual stat (yards/receptions)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each position has a stable regression pattern across seasons; slope is invariant to individual player variance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no 2025 data exists for a position, slope defaults to neutral value.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to linear regression kernel applied per position class.
layer2.telemetry: R-squared of slope fit against historical stat blocks.

primitives.name: Injury Status Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: `not listed` means the name is absent from that game's out, doubtful, and questionable arrays.
primitives.assumptions: Injury statuses are mutually exclusive and fully describe availability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When injury data is missing, filter assumes full availability.

layer2.mapping: Filters player eligibility based on injury context from game-specific JSON.
layer2.telemetry: Fraction of players filtered due to injury status.

The dualities lie between statistical regression and situational availability—regression models predict outcomes while injury filtering determines applicability. Failure modes include missing 2025 data leading to undefined slopes, or misclassification of injury status. The system avoids probabilistic voting or live updates, maintaining deterministic calibration.
